source: Askin, Hadar & Conway-Smith, 'Enhancing Metacognitive AI: Knowledge-Graph Population with Graph-Theoretic LLM Enrichment' -- Table 3 (Google Research Natural Questions examples)
note: Each question gets its own frozen seed (seeds/seed_<id>.json). Both pipelines (original MKGE and ours) run on the same seed. 'use' = include in the current round of runs.

questions.question: Where was High School Musical 2 filmed?
questions.paper_before: Mentions only East High School in Salt Lake City.
questions.paper_after: Corrects to the Entrada at Snow Canyon Country Club in St. George, Utah, noting golf-course and pool scenes.

questions.question: Who owns the rights to Alice in Wonderland?
questions.paper_before: Claims Disney 'holds the rights' to the story.
questions.paper_after: Clarifies Carroll's novel is public-domain; Disney owns only its 1951 and 2010 screen adaptations.

questions.question: Where did the first African-American Air Force unit train?
questions.paper_after: Adds the unit's name -- Tuskegee Airmen -- and specifies Moton Field training site.

questions.question: What causes monsoon winds to change direction seasonally?
questions.paper_before: Differential heating reverses land-sea pressure gradients.
questions.paper_after: Adds the south-west vs. north-east wind pair and explains summer land-heating versus winter ocean-heating moisture transport.

questions.question: What are the requirements to pass the South African National Senior Certificate?
questions.paper_before: Lists 40% in three and 30 percent in three subjects.
questions.paper_after: Gives full checklist: 40% in three (incl. home-language), 30% in three more, six subjects total, pass at least five.
